newsitem.title: USA: Harsco Corp long-term rating raised-Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Harsco Corp long-term rating raised-Moody's.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 18 - Moody's Investors Service on Friday said it raised the unsecured long term debt rating of Harsco Corporation to A3 from Baa1 and confirmed the short term debt rating at Prime-2.
The rating agency said the upgrade reflected the company's improving margins, increased cash flows, significant debt reduction, and prospects for earnings growth over the intermediate term.

Moody's expects that niche acquisitions will complement Harsco's organic growth opportunities, and modest share repurchases will continue, however the company will maintain a conservative financial profile.

Ratings raised are: rated notes and IRB's to A3 from Baa1, shelf rating for senior unsecured securities to (P)A3 from (P)Baa1, shelf rating for subordinated securities to (P)Baa1 from (P)Baa2, and shelf rating for preferred securities to (P)"baa1" from (P)"baa2."
The Prime-2 short term debt rating was confirmed.

Moody's noted that Harsco has expanded margins through cost containment programs, reorganization into eight divisions, enhanced product offerings, and a business mix shift towards industrial service business from manufacturing products. Harsco is recognized as a global leader in providing metal reclamation and mill services to the steel and other metallurgical industries through Heckett Multiserve.
Approximately $2.6 billion of long term contracts in 130 plants in 30 countries provide geographic diversity that dampens business cycle volatility in any one area.

The four divisions of the Infrastructure and Construction business segment offer railroad tie and track maintenance, scaffolding and concrete forming equipment, industrial grating and bridge decking, and roofing granules and abrasives materials.
Increased spending for infrastructure projects worldwide and trends toward outsourcing offer solid growth opportunities, the rating agency noted.

The three divisions in the Process Industry Products business segment produce a wide range of products such as gas containment cylinders, industrial pipe fittings, heat exchangers, boilers, and valve and gauges for a variety of industries.

Both revenues and operating profit have increased at double digit rates. Harsco's defense business is conducted through its 40% interest in United Defense, L.P., a joint venture with FMC Corporation. The company's share of equity income in 1995 was $57 million and represented approximately 31% of Harsco's total operating profit and 18% of cash flow in the form of dividends. Moody's expects earnings growth in core business segments will reduce the importance of the equity income and cash dividends coming from this sector. Harsco Corporation, headquartered in Camp Hill, PA, offers global customers a variety of industrial products and services through its three core operating groups: Metal Reclamation and Mill Services; Infrastructure and Construction; and Process Industry Products.
